title: PR #92: fix(node): make block timestamps deterministic
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Root cause
The canonical node producer derived block timestamps from `SystemTime::now()`, making block contents depend on wall-clock state.

## Fix
- Remove runtime wall-clock input from block production.
- Use the canonical 360-second block interval.
- Derive the next block timestamp from `parent.timestamp + 360` with checked overflow handling.

This preserves deterministic block construction and does not weaken any gate.
